<thought>Based on the observed isotopic pattern—a strong M+1 peak (~11 % of the monoisotopic intensity) consistent with roughly ten carbon atoms, and no significant M+2 peak that would indicate chlorine, bromine, or a high‑abundance sulfur isotope—the only element that can be definitively identified from the pattern is carbon.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
